## This repository
Godot Codely changes a Godot project from the `godot-codely` command. That command uses the `godot-c
odely-lite` preset, the Godot skills, and the Godot MCP server. `.tscn` and `.gd` files are edited a
s text, so the Godot editor does not have to stay open. `project.run`, `project.export`, and `editor
.launch` need `GODOT_PATH`.
The desktop host under the command is DSH Desktop, pinned to `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2`. This for
k publishes source. Signed macOS builds and the Windows NSIS installer on the upstream website and u
pstream GitHub Releases are the original DSH Desktop. Those files leave out the Godot command, prese
ts, and MCP from this repository.
## Run from source
Early testers: use this fork's Releases and check the version's supported platforms and known limita
tions. See the seed user guide (Chinese) for installation, a first task and feedback.
Node.js 22 or later.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A task uses a model configuration you add yourself. The command shape is in the Godot stack readme.
Leave API keys out of the repository, issues, and logs.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The profile name is `godot-codely`. With `DSH_HOME` unset, the command-line profile and shared memor
ies live under `~/.godot-codely`. The desktop window keeps its own data in the `godot-codely` app-da
ta directory (`godot-codely-dev` for a development build) and does not open the upstream `dsh-deskto
p` directory. It is a separate process and provisions the same Godot preset when it starts:

Setup, checks, and packaging are in the development guide. Runtime boundaries are in the architectur
hecks, and packaging are in the development guide. Runtime boundaries are in the architecture notes.
## Host behavior that comes along
These parts belong to the forked desktop host.
- PPT mode writes editable PPTX. Offline DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX skills ship with bundled Python librar

ies on macOS and Windows. See the PPT runtime guide.
- A paired phone can continue a session. Cloudf

lare Quick Tunnel is the usual remote path. Pinggy is the fallback when Cloudflare is unavailable.
-
Safe Mode blocks third-party plugins and keeps user data. If the window cannot open, pass `--safe-m

ode`. After you package this fork on macOS: `open -a "Godot Codely" --args --safe-mode`.
- Portable

Agent presets use `.dshpreset` packages.
- The host can be packaged as a signed macOS DMG/ZIP or a c
ode-signed Windows x64 NSIS installer. After signing secrets and the Windows self-hosted signer are
configured on GitHub, **Orchestrate desktop release** triggers formal or pre-releases into Releases.
See Release automation and the release runbook. Linux x64 has an AppImage build and native CI check
s; use it only when the selected release includes that asset. Linux does not bundle the Office runti
me. Windows ARM64 is unsupported.
## Upstream community
Godot Codely is an independently maintained, unofficial community project built on DeepSeek Harness,
forked from DSH Desktop, and integrated with Godot Engine. See Upstream collaboration for project s
haring, contribution channels, and compatibility work.
The WeChat group and Discord below are the upstream DSH Desktop community.
Upstream DSH Desktop Discord
## Contributing

- Contributing — issues and the checks to run before a pull request
- Development guide — setup, val

idation, patches, and packaging
- Architecture — startup, data, security boundaries, recovery, phone
access, and updates
Before a change, run `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run build`, then exercise the flow yo
hange, run `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run build`, then exercise the flow you touched.

Godot Codely is released under the MIT License. The copyright notice in that file stays with DataEle
ment, the upstream desktop authors. DeepSeek Harness and the vendored Godot MCP trees keep their own
upstream desktop authors. DeepSeek Harness and the vendored Godot MCP trees keep their own licenses.
